decisions.reason: As a flagship product with repeated Gold awards in 2023 and 2024, it clearly exceeds aspiration levels and strongly justifies retaining resources in this line.
Because it remained prominently offered through 2024 while other new bread variants disappeared, management would read its performance as at least satisfactory relative to aspiration and keep it.

Its continued dedicated presentation in 2023 and 2024 suggests acceptable results and enough organisational slack to retain this close-to-core seasonal product, even if it is less clearly outstanding than the flagship stollen.
